description: Free, no account needed. Read one three.ws catalog item in full by its id from search_catalog (for example "object:adjustable_wrench"): metadata, license, CDN urls, the site links that preview or edit it, related items of the same kind, and which source frameworks get_item_source can emit for it.

id.description: Catalog id as `<kind>:<name>` from search_catalog. A bare name is also accepted.

name: get_catalog_item
title: Read one catalog item
